item.title: WRE News: South Florida Tourism Heats Up as Spring Break & World Cup Near
item.description: Miami, FL - February 25, 2026 - After a softer close to 2025, the new year is bringing renewed momentum across the region, particularly in Miami-Dade County. According to the Greater Miami & Miami Beach Convention and Visitors Bureau, hotel rates and revenues jumped into the double digits in January, with average nightly rates nearing $280 — second only to San Francisco among major U.S. markets.
